want: to set a monthly spending limit for each category
soThat: I can track whether my actual spending stays within my planned budget
acceptance: a Budget screen is accessible from the bottom navigation bar
a currency selector lets the user switch between THB and IDR budgets
each category row shows the category name, budget limit, and current month spending
a linear progress bar in each row shows how much of the budget has been used
rows where spending exceeds the budget are highlighted in the error colour
tapping a row opens an inline edit field to update the budget limit
saving a budget limit persists it to the budgets table in Supabase
